message: `{net_type}` is a discrete-domain net type, which LRM Annex C excludes from Verilog-A, so it may not qualify the port declaration `{dir} {net_type} ...`
description: Net types such as `wire` and `tri` describe digital nets. Annex C excludes them from Verilog-A; a continuous net takes its type from its discipline.
actions: Write `{dir} <discipline> ...` (for example `{dir} electrical ...`), or declare the direction and the discipline in two statements.
